title: Tableau gate sequence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with binary tape symbols, and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. Define a sequence of gate lists $(G_t)_{t\ge 0}$ by $G_0=[\text{false constant gate},\text{true constant gate}]$ and, for each $t\ge 0$, by appending to $G_t$ the gates obtained by embedding all tableau gadgets for $M$, with source vertices determined by $n$ and $t$ and base index determined by $n$ and $t$, to form $G_{t+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
A natural number input length n
A natural number time parameter, with the gate list defined recursively from time zero
